info.textSample: Menu Our Story Locations Contact Catering Pickup/Delivery Shop Rewards App! 咥一回想二回 THE XI'AN CLASSICS Our StorySee Menu B2 孜然羊肉夹馍 Spicy Cumin Lamb Burger NS1 孜然羊肉汤扯面 Spicy Cumin Lamb Hand-Ripped Noodles In Soup N4 腊汁猪肉干扯面 Stewed Pork Hand-Ripped Noodles NS4 腊汁猪肉汤扯面 Stewed Pork Hand-Ripped Noodles in Soup “Xi'an Famous Foods made a mark on the city's culinary world with its hand-pulled noodles and spicy Chinese fare.” “...they have customers who are fresh-off-the-boat Chinese immigrants or tourists; on the other end, they’ve gained followers with absolutely no Chinese heritage” “What's more satisfying...than a hearty, warm bowl of spicy beef with hand-pulled noodles?” “[Their] meteoric New York City rise...is a better example of the American dream than most fiction.” WOULD I PREFER TO EAT AT THE GREATEST RESTAURANT IN THE WORLD OR THIS ON AN AVERAGE DAY? YEAH, I’D PREFER TO EAT HERE. Anthony Bourdain XFF GET TO KNOW US First, we were a bubble tea shop. Then, we were a little cart parked off the street next to the Q58 bus stop. Now, we’re a NYC legend expanding beyond the Big Apple. And we still serve the real deal: Noodles, dumplings, burgers, and our proprietary chili oil with 30+ ingredients. ‍ The father: David, a hot head, the mastermind behind the flavors. The son: Jason (me), a chili head, the business guy who wanted to share our food with everyone. ‍ We don’t always get along, but somehow we made it a family business. info.textSample: Menu Our Story Locations Contact Catering Pickup/Delivery Shop Rewards App! MENU Family recipes so good, they're famous We make our family's versions of Xi’an classics. Think: biang-biang noodles pulled to order, dumplings doused in our signature dipping sauce, and a refreshing, vinegary liang pi for hot summer days (or any day). Please review our nutrition facts and allergen information for when dishes are not spicy/least spicy or when they are made as regular/default spicy (the chili oil amount makes a difference calories-wise!)
